text: してんのうの　カンナ　かえって　きたわ…！

structure.jp: してんのうの　カンナ

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb shows the movement is toward where the speaker is now. かえって　きた = 'came back here'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, womanly way to state something firmly. きたわ = 'I have come'.
